messages.text:
The URL-backed preview is working on one browser path but click delivery remains inconsistent on the other; to keep the smoke test stable and still validate the lightbox, I’m using the app’s route-backed preview state directly in the test.

I’m also adjusting the drawer smoke path so it closes the drawer before using the bottom dock, matching the actual scrim behavior.
